talking_points: OpenAI and Anthropic are now publishing details of when their own models have lied, cheated or gone rogue, but critics say self-policing won't be enough.
Tech CEOs are publicly split on whether to slow AI development, with Zuckerberg and Nvidia's Huang pushing back hard against Anthropic's caution.
Wall Street is increasingly nervous about the mountain of debt being used to fund AI data centres, even as fresh mega-deals like the $22bn Blackstone-Alphabet chip financing keep landing.
